tools.name: audit_bot_code
tools.description: Input one JS/TS source file (string). Returns findings for: testnet-as-USD, silent-zero balance, cooldown key mismatch, fake faucet endpoint, speculative earnings text.

tools.name: demo_audit
tools.description: Runs the scanner on a small built-in bad-bot sample and returns the findings. Free; no x402 payment.

tools.name: get_token_price
tools.description: Live DEX spot price, liquidity, FDV, market cap and 24h volume for any token by contract address — EVM (Base/etc.) or Solana mint. Highest-liquidity pair. Cheap per-call market quote ($0.001 USDC via x402).

tools.name: search_tokens
tools.description: Search crypto tokens by name or symbol; returns the highest-liquidity matched pairs with price, liquidity, FDV and 24h volume across chains. Cheap per-call market lookup ($0.001 USDC via x402).

tools.name: top_markets
tools.description: Market-cap table with price, market cap, 24h volume and 1h/24h/7d change. Public aggregator snapshot, not an oracle. Metered per call via x402.

tools.name: chain_tvl
tools.description: Value locked in USD per chain, ranked. TVL is a protocol-reported metric, not a risk measure. Metered per call via x402.

tools.name: stablecoin_supply
tools.description: Circulating USD-pegged supply with peg mechanism and chain count. Metered per call via x402.

tools.name: trending_tokens
tools.description: Tokens currently bought into by projects for DEX exposure, enriched with price, liquidity and 24h volume. Boosts are paid promotions, not an endorsement. Metered per call via x402.

tools.name: gas_prices
tools.description: Gas price, base fee and block height for Base and Arbitrum from public RPC — what a transaction costs before you send it. Metered per call via x402.
